name: SPIA-benchmark
description:
SPIA: Subject-level PII Inference Assessment
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

SPIA is the first benchmark for subject-level privacy assessment in text anonymization. Unlike existing methods that focus on single-target or span-based evaluation, SPIA captures inference-based privacy risks across all data subjects in a document.
